title: Buying his first cornet from the Sears catalog
summary: He saved six months to buy a 6.95 cornet from Sears and taught himself from the instruction book. He talks about cornet versus trumpet and his mouthpieces.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
